description: Single-file calendar planner: month and week views with drag-to-create events, event CRUD with categories/colors and recurrence (daily/weekly/monthly), conflict detection, agenda list, navigation today/prev/next, search, localStorage persistence.

criteria: calendar_planner_model_01.html is one self-contained calendar planner (no libraries): month and week grids rendered from real date math (correct weekday alignment and month lengths), drag on empty grid space to create an event plus full edit/delete dialog with title, time range, category colors and recurrence rules for daily/weekly/monthly with an end condition, recurring instances expanded correctly across views, overlap/conflict warnings, an agenda view listing upcoming events, today/prev/next navigation and a date picker, search over event titles, and localStorage persistence with demo data seeding on first run. No impossible dates or silent data loss.
